parts.name: Fan Blades
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of the rotating blades of the ceiling fan, typically made of lightweight aluminum for efficient air movement.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades are responsible for circulating air when the motor rotates them, creating airflow in the room.
parts.Movement_description: The blades rotate around the central hub when powered by the motor, converting rotational motion into air movement.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural body of the ceiling fan, including the motor housing and mounting rod, made of steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: The base body houses the motor and supports the blades, connecting the fan to the ceiling mount and ensuring stable operation.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary while the internal motor drives the rotation of the blades.
